# Lyme Plumbing & Heating

> Plumbing, heating and air source heat pump engineer based in High Lane, Stockport (SK6). Callum Broadfoot. No gas or boiler work.

Callum Broadfoot is a sole trader, trading as Lyme Plumbing & Heating, based in High Lane, Stockport (SK6). He does the plumbing and heating jobs around the house across Stockport, Cheshire and the High Peak: plumbing, bathrooms, radiators, underfloor heating, unvented cylinders, heating controls and air source heat pumps on the plumbing side. He doesn't do boiler or gas work. If it's the boiler, you'll need a gas engineer. The person who quotes the job is the person who does it.

## Services

- [Plumbing jobs](https://lymeplumbing.co.uk/services/plumbing/): Toilets, basins, taps, outside taps and leaks.
- [Bathrooms](https://lymeplumbing.co.uk/services/bathrooms/): Baths, showers, basins, toilets and towel rails.
- [Emergency plumbing](https://lymeplumbing.co.uk/services/emergency-plumber/): Leaks and water where it shouldn't be.
- [Leak detection](https://lymeplumbing.co.uk/services/leak-detection/): Finding the source, then stopping it.
- [Radiators](https://lymeplumbing.co.uk/services/radiators/): New radiators, swaps, moves and valves.
- [Underfloor heating](https://lymeplumbing.co.uk/services/underfloor-heating/): Wet underfloor heating, manifolds and room controls.
- [Heat pumps](https://lymeplumbing.co.uk/services/heat-pumps/): Installation, repair and servicing, on the plumbing side.
- [Heat pump servicing](https://lymeplumbing.co.uk/services/heat-pump-servicing/): Annual servicing, fault-finding and repairs on an air source heat pump.
- [Unvented cylinders](https://lymeplumbing.co.uk/services/unvented-cylinders/): Mains-pressure hot water cylinders.
- [Heating controls](https://lymeplumbing.co.uk/services/heating-controls/): Thermostats, timers, programmers and valves.
- [Smart controls](https://lymeplumbing.co.uk/services/smart-controls/): Room-by-room temperatures and schedules.
- [Heating faults](https://lymeplumbing.co.uk/services/heating-faults/): Cold radiators, pumps, valves and pressure loss on the system side.
- [System flush](https://lymeplumbing.co.uk/services/system-flush/): A mains water system flush that sends water both ways through the pipes and radiators.
